zh.title: 紐幾內亞航空波音767航班達沃緊急降落：右發動機火警指示，146人滑梯撤離無人受傷
zh.summary: 紐幾內亞航空PX19航班自香港飛往莫爾茲比港途中，右發動機出現火警指示，機組關閉發動機後轉降菲律賓達沃，137名乘客與9名機組員全數經滑梯撤離，無人受傷。
body: 紐幾內亞航空一架波音767-300客機執行PX19航班，自香港飛往莫爾茲比港，機上載有137名乘客與9名機組員。航班在達沃市東北方約160海里、高度3.3萬英尺巡航時，機組收到右發動機火警指示，隨即依檢查單處置並關閉該發動機。機組轉降菲律賓達沃國際機場，飛機安全降落於05跑道，脫離跑道後停在跑道外淨空區，全員經滑梯撤離。事件中4條主輪胎洩氣，無人受傷，實際是否發生火警仍待調查。
紐幾內亞航空表示，機組依標準程序關閉並固定受影響的發動機，航班轉降達沃並安全降落，乘客已撤離並送往航廈。菲律賓民航局表示，機組通報疑似右發動機火花或火警指示後要求非預定降落，調查將納入機組陳述，飛機損傷情況目前尚無資訊。達沃機場一度暫停其他航班起降以利緊急應變與跑道檢查，兩班抵達的國內航班因此取消，檢查完成後已恢復運作，旅客亦獲協助與住宿安排。

en.title: Air Niugini Boeing 767 diverts to Davao after right-engine fire indication; all 146 evacuate by slide, no injuries
en.summary: Air Niugini flight PX19 from Hong Kong to Port Moresby diverted to Davao in the Philippines after a fire indication in the right engine. All 137 passengers and 9 crew evacuated by slide, with no injuries reported.
body: An Air Niugini Boeing 767-300, registration P2-PXW, operating flight PX-19 from Hong Kong to Port Moresby with 137 passengers and 9 crew, was en route at FL330 about 160nm northeast of Davao City when the crew received an indication of a fire in the right-hand engine, a Pratt & Whitney PW4060. The crew worked the related checklist and shut the engine down, then diverted to Davao International Airport, landing safely on runway 05. The aircraft vacated the runway and stopped clear of it, and was evacuated via slides. Four main tyres deflated. No injuries have been reported, and whether an actual fire occurred has not been established.

The airline said: "The crew followed standard procedures and shut down and secured the affected engine." The Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines said the pilots reported an indicator warning of possible sparks or fire in the right engine and requested an unscheduled landing shortly after midnight, and that the investigation would include statements from the pilots. Davao airport temporarily suspended other flight operations for the emergency response and runway safety inspections, two arriving domestic flights were cancelled, and operations resumed after the checks. Passengers and crew were escorted to the terminal and given assistance and hotel accommodation, and no immediate information was available about possible damage to the aircraft.

facts.claim: An Air Niugini Boeing 767-300, registration P2-PXW, operated flight PX-19 from Hong Kong to Port Moresby with 137 passengers and 9 crew.
At FL330 about 160nm northeast of Davao City, the crew received an indication of a fire in the right-hand engine (PW4060), worked the related checklist and shut the engine down.
The aircraft diverted to Davao City, landed safely on runway 05, vacated the runway and stopped clear of it, and was evacuated via slides; four main tyres deflated and no injuries were reported.
The airport was closed for about two hours.

The airline said the crew followed standard procedures and shut down and secured the affected engine, and that the flight diverted to Davao and landed safely with passengers evacuated to the terminal.

The Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines said the pilots received an indicator warning of possible sparks or fire in the right engine and requested an unscheduled landing shortly after midnight, and that the investigation would include statements from the pilots.

Two arriving domestic flights were cancelled while Davao airport suspended other operations for the emergency response, and operations resumed after safety inspections of the main runway; passengers received assistance and hotel accommodation.
